# Tempo Map

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TempoMap`](gmeow-TempoMap.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TempoMap>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A [`TimeMapping`](gmeow-TimeMapping.md) from a musical-time frame to a clock-time frame, expressed piecewise as constant, linear ramp, curve, or measured segments. Tempo is a frame mapping, not a single number, unless it happens to be one ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeMapping`](gmeow-TimeMapping.md)

Use [`gmeow:TempoMap`](gmeow-TempoMap.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeMapping`](gmeow-TimeMapping.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
